Worker USD base / annual burden: KR 2,075 / 39,182; TW 1,341 / 22,699; SG 2,234 / 35,478; MY 549 / 9,081; TH 490 / 8,815; ID 385 / 6,272; VN 302 / 5,270; PH 303 / 4,858. Engineer: KR 2,778 / 44,277; TW 1,704 / 30,796; SG 3,285 / 51,061; MY 1,011 / 16,658; TH 830 / 14,105; ID 513 / 8,545; VN 538 / 9,100; PH 428 / 7,736.
